localizedValues.name: C1
localizedValues.description: Two Room Cabin, Covered Porch, No Tenting Allowed Around Cabins. This is the only Pet Friendly cabin at Conconully. Per night pet fee applies, declare pets and pay fee when you make reservation or check in at the park. Read and understand pet rules. No cooking or smoking in the cabins. You may want to bring warm clothing as nights are cooler. Restrooms and showers are nearby.

localizedValues.name: C2
localizedValues.description: One Room Cabin, Covered Porch, No Tenting Allowed Around Cabin. NO pets, no cooking, no smoking inside this cabin. Bring your own bedding. You may want to bring warm clothing as nights are cooler. Please note: There are no pets allowed in or at cabins C2 - C5, any violation will result in eviction and loss of fees. Restrooms and showers are nearby.
